profile.about: I’m Daniel, a software engineer working at the intersection of AI and product engineering. At eGain, I build conversational systems spanning telephony integrations, AI runtimes, full-stack authoring tools, and cloud infrastructure. My background in computer science and mathematics also shapes my work with language models, retrieval, and educational feedback.
profile.resumeSummary: Software engineer building production conversational AI systems across Genesys telephony integrations, Python runtimes, full-stack tools, and AWS infrastructure. Experience with real-time voice agents, workflow automation, retrieval-augmented generation, and LLM fine-tuning.

caseStudies.title: Real-time voice agents
caseStudies.summary: A real-time conversational voice system connecting phone calls through Genesys to a streaming AI runtime, knowledge retrieval, and speech generation.
caseStudies.contribution: Designed and implemented the telephony-to-AI system, including Genesys connectivity, a reusable Python voice runtime, and bidirectional audio streaming.
caseStudies.challenge: Keeping conversations responsive through interruptions, reconnects, and timeouts while isolating state for every call.
details: Built Genesys connectivity for call-session lifecycle management, media-protocol handling, connection validation, control messages, playback notifications, and operational logging.
Implemented audio-format conversion, interruption and barge-in handling, connection recovery, isolated per-call state, interruption-aware cancellation, and graceful timeout recovery.
Coordinated knowledge retrieval, intent processing, follow-up questions, and speech generation, with safeguards against using unvalidated information in generated responses.
Developed a supporting browser voice client with microphone capture, audio playback, connection controls, real-time audio visualization, tool-execution states, and WebSocket connection recovery.

Containerized the service for AWS deployment with health checks, access controls, secrets management, and centralized logging; added automated tests across protocols, orchestration, latency management, and failure recovery.

caseStudies.title: AI workflow authoring and execution
caseStudies.summary: Visual authoring and execution tools for customer-support workflows, spanning typed variables, API actions, branching, and AI or human handoffs.
caseStudies.contribution: Owned features from requirements through release: React/TypeScript authoring interfaces, Python/Pydantic APIs, OpenAPI contracts, and DynamoDB models.
caseStudies.challenge: Preserving valid references, version history, and session context as workflows are edited, published, and executed.
details: Built draft and publication lifecycles, read-only previews, publish-time validation, and compatibility with legacy records.
Implemented session-context propagation between pre-chat workflows, customer widgets, WebSocket services, and conversational AI pipelines.
Strengthened message ordering, execution recovery, variable normalization, and loop prevention, with tests across authoring, API, persistence, and runtime behavior.

caseStudies.title: ASSISTments educational feedback
caseStudies.summary: Language-model fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented generation for feedback on students’ responses to math questions.
caseStudies.contribution: Fine-tuned LLMs with QLoRA, trained models with TensorFlow on millions of student responses, and implemented FAISS-based retrieval.
caseStudies.challenge: Using relevant student-response data to improve the accuracy of generated educational feedback and scores.
details: Developed model-training and feedback-improvement strategies using millions of student responses.
Implemented a FAISS vector database for retrieval-augmented feedback and scoring, improving generated-content accuracy by 30%.
